title: Three helpers in a chain
prompt: Write `add_one`, `double` and `square`, each returning what its name says. `chained` returns the result of adding one, then doubling, then squaring n. chained(1) is 16.
hints: A returned value can go straight into the next call; inner calls happen first.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.
